name: Seijun na Karada wa, Aitsu no Ude no Naka de Otoko o Shitteiku -Kanojo no Shiawasesou na Sugata o, Yubi o Kuwaete Miteirushika Nai Monogatari-
original_name: 清純なカラダは、アイツの腕の中で男を知っていく ―彼女の幸せそうな姿を、指を咥えて見ているしかない物語―
source:
Tatsuya, Goro and Izumi are three childhood friends whom are going to the same school.
One day Tatsuya finds out that Izumi, whom he had liked from childhood, has confessed to someone she likes and later that spring Goro and Izumi starts dating.

Tatsuya silently continues to hide his feelings in favor of his childhood friends as their relationship progress rapidly. 
But inside he suffers as all he can do is to watch them. 
Meanwhile, Goro and Izumi fail to notice Tatsuya’s suffering over his love for Izumi…

[rough translation from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=697609]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
达也、吾郎和泉是就读同一所学校的三名青梅竹马。
某天，达也得知自己从小喜欢的泉已经向心上人告白。随后那个春天，吾郎和泉开始交往。

二人的关系迅速发展，达也为了青梅竹马们默默隐藏自己的感情。
然而，他的内心备受煎熬，因为自己只能在一旁看着他们。
与此同时，吾郎和泉都没有察觉达也因爱着泉而承受的痛苦……

[粗略翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=697609]Getchu[/url]]
